title: SREV-024 KillAll process enumeration count

terminate_apis_shape.description: TerminateJobObject terminates all processes in a job; TerminateProcess terminates one process handle; both APIs define executor behavior only, not Sandboxie PID enumeration

enum_contract.description: SbieApi_EnumProcessEx(..., pids, &count) passes caller capacity; driver Process_Enumerate writes at most *count entries then sets *count = num; valid indexes are 0 <= i < count

terminatejob_default.description: TerminateJob defaults to FALSE and is set TRUE only through the explicit TerminateJobObject policy branch; NoAddProcessToJob/NoSecurityIsolation paths must not leave it uninitialized

iteration_invariant.description: Manual PID termination uses `for (i = 0; i < count; ++i)`; never reads pids[count]

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: KillAll with job termination disabled never sends GUI_KILL_JOB; manual fallback terminates each PID once without reading past the slice; TerminateJobObject-enabled boxes still send GUI job-kill before manual fallback; RPCSS boxed caller still avoids job termination

contracts: Job termination is only selected by explicit policy
Manual fallback iterates exactly the returned PID count
TerminateJob is initialized to FALSE on every path before being read
